title: Deal with Denmark gives US 'permanent control' over Greenland security, Trump says
summary: The deal with Denmark, according to President Donald Trump, would give the US "permanent control" over Greenland's security.

image.caption: Trump said the US would take 'permanent control over security, and all other needs, in Greenland'Image: Odd Andersen/AFP

blocks.text: President Donald Trump announced on Friday that the US had entered into an agreement with Denmark and Greenland that gives the US permanent control over Greenland's security.
In a post on Truth Social, he also wrote that the deal bars US adversaries from establishing bases there.
